sub: TODO: Real AI failures, replayed so you make the calls. Every case ends at the same question: where was the stop button, and who was standing next to it?
footer: TODO: Built from the manuscript Who Could Have Said Stop? (October 2026). Every real fact has a source in its lesson.
questions: TODO: What is it allowed to do, how much and how fast?
TODO: Who checks its work, apart from the people who built it?

TODO: When does someone look at it again?
TODO: What is it really rewarded for?
TODO: Is the safe way also the easy way?
